regime_context: The Fed is in a hawkish staging phase to bank credibility, while Treasury structurally suppresses front-end yields via bill issuance and dealer reform; consensus may see a sustained hawk, but revealed interests point to an eventual pivot toward lower real yields after midterm credibility is secured.
regime_context_zh: 美联储正处于为信用背书的鹰派铺垫阶段，财政部通过国库券发行和交易商改革结构性地压制前端收益率；共识可能认为鹰派将延续，但利益显示在中期选举后获取信誉后将转向更低的实际收益率。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Post-midterm easing pivot will lower long-end yields as the Fed deploys staged optionality; the current hawkish stance is a credibility-banking phase, not the destination.
theses.thesis_zh: 中期选举后的宽松转向将压低长端收益率，因美联储正在部署阶段性的选择权；当前鹰派立场是积累信誉的阶段，并非最终目标。
evidence: Fed path gap: market 13bp more hawkish than dot, but Warsh's framework reset deletes forward guidance and self-binds, preloading cover for a pivot.
Open prediction: No cut through September 2026, but easing optionality post-midterm.
Inflation-frameworks task force recommending strict 2% target provides doctrinal cover to shift to easing later.
theses.dissent: The Fed may never pivot if inflation reaccelerates or Warsh cements a structurally hawkish regime; the dot-plot deletion could entrench higher for longer.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果通胀重新加速或沃什巩固了结构性鹰派体制，美联储可能永远不转向；点阵图的取消可能强化长期高位维持。

falsifier.text: Fed minutes or a Warsh speech explicitly rule out any rate cut before Q2 2027, or the Dec-2026 hike probability exceeds 95%.
falsifier.text_zh: 美联储会议纪要或沃什讲话明确排除2027年第二季度前的任何降息，或2026年12月加息概率超过95%。

theses.subject: XLI
theses.thesis: NATO defense spending super-cycle is structural and budget-locked, boosting industrial sector earnings from defense primes and aerospace commitments regardless of ceasefires.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约国防开支超级周期是结构性的且受预算锁定，无论停火与否，防务龙头及航空航天承诺都将提振工业板块盈利。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle, budget/NATO fact basis.
FACT: Q1 2026 energy inflows show rotation, but defense bid persists.
Industrial sector XLI includes major defense and aerospace companies directly benefiting from sustained commitments.
theses.dissent: Fiscal consolidation pressures or a major peace deal could cap defense budget growth, reducing the premium on industrials exposed to defense.
theses.dissent_zh: 财政整顿压力或重大和平协议可能限制国防预算增长，降低含有防务敞口的工业板块溢价。

falsifier.text: NATO summit announces a formal freeze in defense spending growth targets or US defense appropriations show a real decline for FY2027.
falsifier.text_zh: 北约峰会宣布正式冻结国防开支增长目标，或美国2027财年国防拨款出现实际下降。

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: Dealer-intermediation reform and eSLR changes under Bessent boost dealer bank profitability by increasing T-bill market activity and reducing regulatory drag.
theses.thesis_zh: 贝森特推动的交易商中介改革及补充杠杆率(SLR)调整将通过增加国库券市场活动并减少监管拖累，提升交易商银行盈利能力。
evidence: Treasury dealer-intermediation reform is a FACT lever (theater: dollar/debt).
Front-end Treasuries rotation benefits dealer banks as intermediaries.
theses.dissent: Regulatory reform may stall in Congress; the Fed may push back against loosening leverage rules, limiting upside for bank margins.
theses.dissent_zh: 监管改革可能在国会搁浅；美联储可能反对放松杠杆规定，限制银行利润率的上行空间。

falsifier.text: eSLR reform proposal is formally withdrawn by the Treasury or a relevant regulator announces no changes for 2027.
falsifier.text_zh: 财政部正式撤回补充杠杆率改革提案，或相关监管机构宣布2027年无任何调整。

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: Advanced-chip tariff stays in force and domestic fab buildout continues, insulating the semiconductor value chain from trade truce uncertainty.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税保持不变，国内晶圆厂建设持续推进，使半导体价值链免受贸易休战不确定性的影响。
evidence: China tech war theater: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force (open prediction).
Rotation: domestic semiconductors/fabs (SMH, SOXX) as a targeted theme.
Industrial policy steers capital toward strategic domestic capacity.
theses.dissent: A SCOTUS strike-down of tariff authority or a broader tech trade deal could remove the protection and erode the premium for domestic fabs.
theses.dissent_zh: 最高法院废除关税授权或达成更广泛的技术贸易协议，可能取消保护并侵蚀国内晶圆厂的溢价。

falsifier.text: SCOTUS rules against the tariff statutory authority or the White House rescinds the advanced-chip tariff executive order.
falsifier.text_zh: 最高法院裁定关税法定权限无效，或白宫撤销先进芯片关税行政令。

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI pilot reactors approaching criticality, combined with HALEU fuel cycle support, drives early-stage SMR/advanced nuclear upside.
theses.thesis_zh: 为AI供能的试点核反应堆接近临界，加上HALEU燃料循环支持，推动早期小型模块化反应堆及先进核能概念的上行。
evidence: Rotation: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle (FACT mechanism).
Open prediction: At least one pilot reactor reaches criticality (partial-pass likely with Antares Mark-0).
Industrial policy steers toward strategic domestic capacity for AI compute.
theses.dissent: Regulatory delays, cost overruns, or a reactor failure could derail the nuclear narrative; high valuations already price in success.
theses.dissent_zh: 监管拖延、成本超支或反应堆故障可能破坏核能叙事；高估值已计入成功预期。

falsifier.text: All three pilot reactors fail to receive criticality approval by end-2026 or DOE cuts HALEU fuel cycle funding.
falsifier.text_zh: 截至2026年底，三个试点反应堆均未获得临界批准，或能源部削减HALEU燃料循环资金。
